verdict.rationale: Metronome generates and finalizes invoices itself, and its native Stripe and marketplace integrations automatically create corresponding invoices in Stripe, AWS, Azure and GCP for collection. Custom fields can be attached to Metronome objects. The rest of the story is unevidenced, and customer delivery appears to rely on the downstream invoicing system rather than Metronome itself. Missing for 10: credit notes, receipts, sequential/compliant invoice numbering, memos on invoices, Metronome-native automatic delivery to customers, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, the platform generates compliant invoices, credit notes, and receipts — sequential numbering, custom fields, memos — delivered to customers automatically

citations.quote: when an invoice finalizes at the end of the billing period, Metronome automatically creates a corresponding invoice in Stripe to collect payment
Metronome's out-of-the-box integration that automates the metering to and creation of invoices in AWS, Azure, and GCP
Custom fields are properties that you can add to Metronome objects to store metadata like foreign keys or other descriptors.
